evals.name: tickets-overview
evals.expected_output: Three blocks: assigned open (4101 P1 New, 4105 P2 Triaged), handed over (4090 in Testing with Bob), open PRs (#210 review requested from bob-gh). The failing 'Test Results' check on #210 is labelled inherited (±0 vs base, TestTaxRoundingGBP/CHF). Proposes triage of 4101 as the next action and asks. No writes.
assertions: Shows three separate blocks: assigned open tickets, handed-over tickets, open PRs
Lists 4101 (P1, New) and 4105 (P2, Triaged) as assigned open tickets
Lists 4090 as handed over, in Testing, assigned to Bob
Labels the failing 'Test Results' check on PR #210 as inherited (unchanged vs base) and names TestTaxRoundingGBP/TestTaxRoundingCHF
Proposes triaging 4101 as the next action, as a question with options
Makes no claim of having written to the tracker or GitHub

evals.name: ship-reviewer-is-author
evals.expected_output: Deduces phase ship (In Progress, branch with commits, no PR). Plan: run build (succeeded per fixture), commit only src/cart/CartBadge.tsx with a 'FIX: AB#4120 ...' subject, push, PR to main with Summary/Change/Testing body, reviewer default alice-gh flagged because Alice authored the branch commit, ticket comment with the PR link because the Boards-GitHub link doesn't work. No AI mention anywhere. One confirmation for the whole phase; nothing executed.
assertions: Identifies the phase as ship (In Progress, branch with commits, no PR)
Plans the build/test gate before commit/PR and reports it succeeded per fixture
Commit subject starts with 'FIX: AB#4120'
Plans to stage only src/cart/CartBadge.tsx
No mention of AI assistance (Claude, Co-Authored-By, generated with) in planned commit/PR/comment texts
Warns that the default reviewer alice-gh authored the branch's commit and suggests an alternative
Plans a ticket comment with the PR link because the Boards-GitHub link does not work
Asks a single confirmation for the whole phase and executes nothing
Commit/PR summary reflects the actual diff (badge sums line quantities)

Plan: transition 4130 to Testing with RemainingWork=0 and Custom.ActualTime set (suggested with evidence from In Progress since 2026-10-13T13:00Z / first commit, asked to confirm), assign alice@contoso.com, English handoff comment with branch and PR #215 URL, Teams draft message to Alice. Secret webhook never printed. One confirmation; nothing executed.

Plans transition of 4130 to Testing with RemainingWork = 0
Plans Custom.ActualTime with a suggested value backed by evidence (In Progress since 2026-10-13 13:00Z or first commit) and asks to confirm it
Plans to assign the ticket to alice@contoso.com
Plans an English ticket comment containing the branch name and the PR #215 URL
Provides a Teams message draft addressed to Alice for the user to send
Never prints the secret Teams webhook URL
Asks a single confirmation for the whole phase and executes nothing
Does not offer raw clock time since In Progress (~23h) as a candidate for actual hours

evals.name: connectors-pending
evals.expected_output: Connector check first: reports azure-devops pending (az not logged in) and slack pending (webhook mode, empty secret; webhook not implemented). Offers to configure each (configure now / skip / alternative such as switching Slack to draft). Says the tracker problem blocks the ticket blocks while the notifier one doesn't; can still show the PR block from GitHub if the user skips. Doesn't pretend to list tickets. Notes it will ask again next run until fixed.
assertions: Runs the connector check before the tickets overview and names both pending connectors with their reasons
Offers to configure each pending connector now, with a skip option
Offers switching the Slack notifier to draft mode (or notes webhook mode isn't implemented)
Explains the tracker login blocks the ticket blocks while the notifier issue does not
Does not invent or list tickets from Azure DevOps
States the check will be asked again on later runs until the connectors are configured

evals.name: help-unconfigured
evals.expected_output: Read-only help in Spanish: every subcommand (tickets, triage, start, ship, handoff, status, setup, setup repo, update, help) and the flags --dry-run / --fixtures with examples. Context block: repo contoso/webshop NOT configured under repos:; connectors from the stored status (azure-devops pending: az not logged in) labelled as the last recorded status, not a live check; defaults alice-gh / alice@contoso.com, commit format, branch pattern; last tickets 2026-10-15 16:20; version 1.2.0 with update 1.3.0 available (4 commits) from the cache. Ends with a warning that this repo needs the mini setup and the command `/devflow setup repo`. No connector check, no fetch, no writes, no question at the end; the Teams webhook is masked.
assertions: Lists all subcommands including setup repo, update and help, plus the --dry-run and --fixtures flags
Says the repo contoso/webshop has no entry in the config
Reports azure-devops as pending (stored status) rather than OK, and makes clear it is the recorded status, not a live check
Shows the defaults alice-gh / alice@contoso.com, the commit format and the branch pattern
Shows the last tickets view (2026-10-15) and update 1.3.0 available from the cache, without mentioning 1.4.0 (no fetch)
Ends with a warning that the repo needs setup and the command `/devflow setup repo` in inline code
Does not ask a question at the end and does not offer to apply the update
Never prints the Teams webhook URL or FAKE-SECRET-1234
Does not run or claim to run the connector check, setup or any write

evals.name: help-configured
evals.expected_output: Same command list as help-unconfigured. Context: repo contoso/webshop configured; github, azure-devops and teams ok (stored); reviewer bob-gh (repo override) and tester alice@contoso.com; last tickets: never; version 1.2.0, no update info. No setup warning, no question, no writes.
assertions: Lists all subcommands including setup repo, update and help, plus the --dry-run and --fixtures flags
Says the repo contoso/webshop is configured
Shows all three connectors as ok (stored status)
Shows reviewer bob-gh (the repo override, not alice-gh) and tester alice@contoso.com
Says tickets has never been run (no state)
Shows version 1.2.0
Shows no setup warning and no setup command
Ends without a question and claims no writes

evals.name: update-available
evals.expected_output: Update 1.2.0 → 1.3.0 (4 commits). Shows the 1.3.0 CHANGELOG entries (tickets.show_handed_over added; weekend fix in actual hours) and explains in Spanish what changes for the user. Lists 'CHORE: Tidy eval fixtures' as not in the changelog. Local repo has an uncommitted change in devflow/references/templates.md: plan stash → git merge --ff-only devflow-v1.3.0 → stash pop, with one confirmation, never discarding. Config migration: config.yml lacks tickets.show_handed_over → proposes adding it with default true, shown as a diff, written only after a yes. Dry run: nothing applied, state.yml not written.
assertions: States the update is from 1.2.0 to 1.3.0
Shows the 1.3.0 changelog entries (show_handed_over option, weekend actual-hours fix)
Explains in Spanish what the changes mean for the user, beyond repeating the changelog
Lists 'Tidy eval fixtures' as a commit not in the changelog
Names devflow/references/templates.md as a local uncommitted change and plans stash, fast-forward to devflow-v1.3.0, then stash pop
Does not plan reset, checkout -- or dropping the stash
Proposes adding tickets.show_handed_over: true to config.yml as a migration that needs approval
Asks one confirmation to apply and applies nothing (dry run), without writing state.yml
